description: This image collection distinguishes twenty-six laptop-component categories relevant to electronic-waste disassembly and sorting. East West University and collaborators publish raw and augmented directories covering batteries, processors, memory, screens, cables, cases and other parts. The article describes components from eight HP laptop models sourced through three firms in Bangladesh. Repository version 4 states 140 raw and 560 augmented images per category, implying 18,200 images, while the article reports 29,120; the discrepancy is unresolved. Coverage is selected components, not a representative incoming electronic-waste stream, and acquisition dates were not established. Mendeley states CC BY 4.0 and free access. Limited models, augmentation and the inconsistent count constrain simulation benchmarks and train-test design. Modellers could test sorting-perception components, with data-waste-concern-bangladesh-waste-database supplying separate waste-system context. The page and DOI metadata were readable, but the API returned 502. No image files were downloaded or counted.
